children.text: Lilly Singh opens up her video by talking about mental health and how it depends on a single small tube of chapstick. Because she opens up with this, the audience is drawn into her video, curious if she is being dramatic for saying her mental helath depends on the smallest of everyday objects. She connects the rest of her video and eventually the rest of her message to this statement to this “emotional support chapstick.” She emphasizes how having the chapstick is connected to a feeling of comfort and preparedness. By connecting her message of mental health and expected pattern to something as measily as chapstick, Lilly is able to get her audience to think about their mental health and the small things that make them feel their best. She ties her message to a feeling of readiness and daily pattern.

Lily’s audience for this video is for young women that are social media oriented and who discuss their mental health in relation with their daily routine’s and its expectedness. She is aiming to reach women who expect patterns in their daily life which helps bring stability and comfort to them. She also explicitly says “women” multiple times throughout the video emphasizing her audience is young women. The tone in which she speaks, especially the slang, specifically when she says “Straight Up” and “Damn”, emphasizes the younger generation she is trying to reach, as they prioritize mental health more. The reason she uses this tone and slang is to help increase her viewership and connect with the younger audience who would emphathize with her video.

The vertical orientation of reels frames Lilly as the main visual focus helping emphasize her as the character and amplifying her message. The text captions seen in the video as she speaks allow her to reach a broader audience so that Singh can still deliver her message even when the audience is not able to listen. The purpose of reels is to be short and to catch a user’s attention while they scroll. Singh talks at a fast pace so that she can deliver her message befor the user swipes past the reel. She catches the user’s attention through her first comment about chapsticks effectively capturing the user's attention.
